name: Who’s Coming
intro: You will make a small group, ask it one question and record the answers yourself, all on this phone. Nothing is sent to anyone: the people you add have no phone numbers, so the app only copies the message for you.

steps.do: A white card at the bottom says “Welcome to Who’s Coming”. Tap the small words “skip the tour” in its bottom-right corner.
steps.see: The card now asks “How do you want to start?” with “🧪 Keep the examples to play with” and “✨ Start fresh with my own”.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Start fresh with my own”.
steps.see: A small question box asks “Start fresh? The examples will be cleared.” with Cancel and OK.

steps.do: Tap “OK”.
steps.see: A card asks “What would you like to do?” with “❓ Ask the family something”, “✅ See who has answered” and “👥 My groups and people”.

steps.do: Tap “👥 My groups and people”.
steps.see: The People page opens, with a “New group” box and an “Add group” button.

steps.do: Within a few seconds a card pops up near the bottom: “Keep Who’s Coming on your Home Screen”. Tap “Later” on it.
steps.see: The card goes away.
steps.tip: If the card popped up earlier, just tap “Later” whenever you see it.

steps.do: Leave the “Group name” box empty and tap “Add group”.
steps.see: Nothing happens — no empty group is made.

steps.do: Tap the “Group name” box, type the name below, then tap “Add group”.
steps.see: A new card “Sunday lunch crew” appears at the top with “Nobody in it yet.” and boxes for a Name and Mobile (optional).

steps.do: In that card, tap the “Name” box, type this name (keep the apostrophe), leave Mobile empty, and tap “Add”.
steps.see: Margaret O'Brien is listed, spelled right, with “no number — copy & paste to send” under her name.

steps.do: Do the same for one more person: type the name below in the “Name” box and tap “Add”.
steps.see: Pastor Dan is listed under Margaret O'Brien, also with “no number — copy & paste to send”.

steps.do: Tap the round “?” button near the bottom-right corner.
steps.see: A “Help and settings” panel slides up. One of its choices is “🏠 Start menu: what would you like to do?”.
steps.tip: The ❓ Asks / 👥 People tabs at the very bottom are hidden behind the purple Test copy bar, so we go round through this menu.

steps.do: Tap “🏠 Start menu: what would you like to do?”.
steps.see: The “What would you like to do?” card comes back.

steps.do: Tap “❓ Ask the family something”.
steps.see: An “Ask something” form: “Who are you asking?” already says “Sunday lunch crew (2)”, and “Yes / No / Maybe” is the answer type.

steps.do: Tap the question box, type the question below, then tap “Save and send →”.
steps.type: Sunday lunch at Margaret's, 1pm — who's coming?
steps.see: A box slides up from the bottom: “Your name first”, with a “Your first name” box.

steps.do: Type your first name as below, then press the blue return / Go key on the keyboard.
steps.see: A message box says “No mobile numbers on this group yet — the message is copied. Paste it into your group text, or add numbers under People.” Nothing was sent.
steps.tip: Use the keyboard’s return key — the “Send it” button is hidden behind the purple Test copy bar.

steps.do: Tap “OK” on that message.
steps.see: Your question card shows “Sunday lunch at Margaret's, 1pm — who's coming?”, “Sunday lunch crew · 0 of 2 answered”, three zeros (Yes, No, Maybe), and “not yet” under each person.

steps.do: Under Margaret O'Brien, tap “Yes”.
steps.see: Margaret’s “Yes” button turns green, the Yes count goes to 1, the line says “1 of 2 answered”, and under Margaret it says “Yes ·” with today’s date.

steps.do: Tap “📋 Copy the tally”.
steps.see: A short note says “Copied — paste it anywhere”. (If you like, paste it into Notes: it lists Margaret O'Brien: Yes and Pastor Dan: —.)

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: The question is still there with “1 of 2 answered” and Margaret’s Yes.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then under Pastor Dan, tap “Maybe”.
steps.see: A yellow strip says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” The card now says “2 of 2 answered”, Maybe shows 1, and the “Nudge the quiet ones” button is gone because everyone has answered.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off and scroll back to the top.
steps.see: Your question “Sunday lunch at Margaret's, 1pm — who's coming?” is at the top with “2 of 2 answered”: Margaret O'Brien said Yes and Pastor Dan said Maybe.
